degree_rationale: Maps the four Great Realms (Father, Ambassador, Pillar of Glory, Jesus) and their dark counterparts (the four Nights). This is the essential celestial map — what the cosmos IS in its presiding fourfold structure.
direction_rationale: Establishes the four-directioned foundation of the celestial degree. The day-night, above-below, twelve-hour structures are laid down as primal cartography.
grand_man_function: The celestial four-directional plenum — the cardinal cosmic figures presiding from heart-inmost.
title: The Four Great Realms (Father, Living Spirit, Pillar, Jesus) presiding over the cosmos
